questions.prompt: However, according to a wide array of scientific and sociological research, creativity is 16 a sign of rare genius than a natural human potential.
questions.explanation: less A than B 意為「與其說是 A，不如說是 B」；前一句提到長久以來大家認為創造力是少數人專屬，本句以 However 翻轉，說創造力與其說是天才的標誌，不如說是人類天生的潛能。more 會使語意完全相反，better／worse 則無法與 than 構成這個句型的語意。

questions.prompt: It is believed that taking breaks from a problem can help 17 a moment of insight or stimulate new ideas.
questions.explanation: spark 固定用法「激發」，表示「暫時放下問題休息可以幫助激發靈感的瞬間」；carve（雕刻）、drill（鑽）、grind（研磨）都不合。

questions.prompt: That is why some of the most successful companies in the world, such as 3M and Google, encourage their employees to 18 all sorts of relaxing activities, such as playing pinball and wandering about the campus.
questions.explanation: 【句型】take part in 固定片語「參與」；refer to（提及）、answer for（對……負責）、put up with（忍受）都不合。

questions.prompt: During such breaks, the mind turns inward, 19 it can subconsciously puzzle over subtle meanings and connections.
questions.explanation: where 引導關係副詞子句，先行詞是前面的 the mind turns inward 所形成的「內在境地」；which 之後的子句已完整、無空缺，if 與 but 也無法與逗號前的敘述構成合理邏輯。

questions.prompt: This is because many breakthroughs come up when people venture 20 their usual routines or areas of expertise.
questions.explanation: venture beyond 意為「冒險走出…的範圍」，本句指許多突破來自於人們敢於跨出慣常的做事方式與專業領域；into（進入）語意方向相反，without（沒有）、under（在…之下）都不合。

questions.prompt: Some see it as a celebration related to the turn of the seasons from winter to spring; others, however, believe that it 16 the adoption of a new calendar.
questions.explanation: 【句型】stem from 指「源自於」；leads to（導致，方向相反）、brings out（帶出）、comes across（偶遇）都不合。

questions.prompt: However, many people, either refusing to accept the new date or not having heard about it, 17 to celebrate New Year's Day on April 1.
questions.explanation: 本句主要子句缺少限定動詞，須填過去式 continued；continue 為現在式，與前一句 In 1582 的時間背景不合，continuing 是分詞、to continue 是不定詞，兩者都不能單獨當主要動詞。

questions.prompt: Other people began to make fun of these traditionalists, sending them on “fool's errands” or trying to fool them into believing something false. 18 , the practice spread throughout Europe and the rest of the world.
questions.explanation: 語意「最終，這個習俗傳遍了歐洲」，Eventually（最終）符合這種事件發展的時間順序；Precisely（精確地）、Additionally（此外）、Literally（字面上地）都不合。

questions.prompt: Nowadays, on April Fools' Day, people often 19 to create elaborate hoaxes to fool others.
questions.explanation: go to great lengths to V 是「不遺餘力、費盡心思去做某事」，本句指人們常費盡心思設計精巧的愚人節惡作劇；come to an end（結束）、put into service（使投入使用；in service 為使用中、服役中）、hold in store（不是正確說法，應為 have in store）都不合。

questions.prompt: Newspapers, radio and TV stations, and websites have participated in the April 1 tradition of making 20 reports in order to fool their audiences.
questions.explanation: 語意「製作『虛構的』報導來愚弄觀眾」，fictional（虛構的）符合愚人節惡作劇的語境；essential（必要的）、ancient（古老的）、subjective（主觀的）都不合。

questions.prompt: Over the centuries, henna tattoos 16 used in weddings and holiday celebrations because they are thought to carry blessings from the gods.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式被動語態 have been，配合 Over the centuries（幾個世紀以來，持續到現在），表示指甲花刺青一直被用於婚禮節慶；were being（過去進行式，不符合持續到現在的語意）、will be（未來式）、had to be（過去必須）都不合。

questions.prompt: Today, the ancient art form has found a new 17 in the hands of contemporary artists.
questions.explanation: 語意「這個古老藝術形式在當代藝術家手中找到了新的『應用方式』」，application（應用）符合；competition（競爭）、investigation（調查）、participation（參與）都不合。

questions.prompt: They draw elegant henna crowns on the women's bare heads to help them 18 the loss of their hair after cancer treatment.
questions.explanation: cope with 意為「應付、承受（困難處境）」，本句指指甲花頭冠幫助患者面對化療後掉髮的失落；carry away（多用於 be carried away 忘形）、build on（以…為基礎發展）、get off（下車、脫身）語意都不合。

questions.prompt: Featuring floral patterns, religious symbols, and messages of hope, the painted henna crowns are amazing substitutes for the hats and wigs that the cancer patients would 19 use to cover their heads.
questions.explanation: otherwise 在此是「若非如此、本來」：既然現在有 henna 頭冠當替代品，帽子與假髮就是患者「本來會用」的東西。moreover（此外）、altogether（總共、完全）、namely（也就是）語意都不合。

questions.prompt: Many women report that the henna crowns really work as a healing device, helping them build a more 20 self-image at a time when they are vulnerable and depressed.
questions.explanation: 語意「幫助她們建立更『正向』的自我形象」，positive（正向的）符合這種心理療癒的語境；general（一般的）、flexible（有彈性的）、considerate（體貼的）都不合。
